authors: Roijers D. M.; Vamplew P.; Whiteson S.; Dazeley R.
title: A Survey of Multi-Objective Sequential Decision-Making
task_and_mechanism: taxonomy of multi-objective sequential decision making
source_supported_claim: Multi-objective decision making requires explicit treatment of preferences and solution concepts
relation_to_case_a: Methodological basis rather than nearest technical analogue
unverified_or_limit: A survey cannot demonstrate absence of any later method

authors: Wirth C.; Akrour R.; Neumann G.; Fürnkranz J.
title: A Survey of Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning Methods
task_and_mechanism: survey of learning from qualitative preferences
source_supported_claim: PbRL can learn from preferences instead of predesigned scalar rewards
relation_to_case_a: Disproves claim that preference learning itself is novel
unverified_or_limit: Does not evaluate case A configurations

authors: Christiano P. F.; Leike J.; Brown T.; Martic M.; Legg S.; Amodei D.
title: Deep Reinforcement Learning from Human Preferences
task_and_mechanism: learn reward model from human comparisons
source_supported_claim: Learned preference reward can support RL tasks
relation_to_case_a: Shows learned reward and pairwise feedback are preexisting
unverified_or_limit: Not a direct test of multicriteria IS configuration selection

title: A practical guide to multi-objective reinforcement learning and planning
task_and_mechanism: utility-based solution concepts and preference choice
baseline_or_comparison: linear scalar reward and multi-policy methods
source_supported_claim: Choice of utility and available preferences conditions MORL design
relation_to_case_a: Requires careful baseline selection and semantics of utility
unverified_or_limit: Not an empirical baseline on case A data

authors: Basaklar T.; Gumussoy S.; Ogras U.
title: PD-MORL: Preference-Driven Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Algorithm
task_and_mechanism: single preference-conditioned policy over preference space
source_supported_claim: Single network is trained to cover varying preferences
relation_to_case_a: Counterexample to generic novelty of preference-conditioned networks
unverified_or_limit: Results not transferable to case A without new protocol

authors: Liu Y.; Zhou Y.; He Z.; Yang Y.; Han Q.; Li J.
title: Dynamic preference inference network: Improving sample efficiency for multi-objective reinforcement learning by preference estimation
task_and_mechanism: neural inference of trajectory preference in MORL
source_supported_claim: Neural preference inference is already a published method
relation_to_case_a: Strong counterexample to novelty of context-related neural aggregation
unverified_or_limit: Full protocol and numerical results require inspection of complete text

authors: Lu J.; Mannion P.; Mason K.
title: Inferring preferences from demonstrations in multi-objective reinforcement learning
evaluation_or_data: Deep Sea Treasure; Traffic; Item Gathering
source_supported_claim: Preferences can be inferred without online user interaction
relation_to_case_a: Strong analogue for inferring priorities and constructing comparisons
unverified_or_limit: Demonstrations differ from labelled pairwise choices

authors: Mu N.; Luan Y.; Jia Q.-S.
title: Preference-Based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
task_and_mechanism: explicit multi-objective reward model aligned to preference data
source_supported_claim: Integrates preference reward modeling with MORL
relation_to_case_a: Direct counterexample to claiming first reward model for MORL
unverified_or_limit: Need inspect assumptions to establish any residual difference

authors: Cao X.; Quan D.; Zhang Z.; Wang S.
title: Learning What Matters Now: Dynamic Preference Inference under Contextual Shifts
source_supported_claim: Context-shift adaptation is already studied in a 2026 preprint
relation_to_case_a: Most direct challenge to broad context-dependence claim
unverified_or_limit: Preprint status and external replication not established

authors: Yang Y.; Zhou T.; Pechenizkiy M.; Fang M.
title: Preference Controllable Reinforcement Learning with Advanced Multi-Objective Optimization
evaluation_or_data: multi-objective environments with up to six objectives
source_supported_claim: Preference-conditioned control and broader Pareto coverage have prior art
relation_to_case_a: Counterexample to claims about preference-controlled novelty
